data.one_liner: Consume Server-Sent Events (SSE) APIs with support for GET and POST requests.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter and Dart applications to connect to Server-Sent Events endpoints using GET or POST requests with custom headers and body payloads. It streams parsed events providing the event ID, event type, and data payload.
use_when: You need to consume a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream from a backend
You need to send custom headers or a request body with your SSE connection
avoid_when: You are using WebSockets for bidirectional real-time communication
strengths: Supports both GET and POST requests for SSE
Auto-retry mechanism for connection errors and backend downtime
Parses event id, event type, and data out of the box
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic README examples
